s: The article explores how AI can overcome inherent human limitations and social stratification in achieving self-improvement and mastery, drawing parallels to principles of compound growth, Ikigai, and the physics of momentum.
sub: Leveraging AI for personal growth and skill acquisition beyond self-bootstrap limitations.
The challenges of self-guided learning and the need for effective mentorship.
Analyzing wealth distribution (Pareto Principle) and historical anomalies of the middle class in relation to opportunity.
AI's role in providing access to knowledge and personalized learning paths, circumventing traditional barriers.
